text: Which Gemini model should you use? Gemini 4 Neon joins seven other models, measured on the same questions through the same Gemini API endpoint. Answer four questions, and stop at the first yes.
Question one. Must it be free, or run on your own hardware? Use Gemma 4 31B. It scored 0.9735 on GSM8K math and 0.9675 on function calls, free on the Gemini API free tier or on your own GPU.

text: Question two. Is the work easy, such as short questions and simple function calls? Use 3.5 Flash-Lite, at $0.66 per 1,000 math problems and 1.10 seconds each. Or use 3.8 Flash for a higher score, 0.9788.

text: Question three. Does it need high thinking, where you would otherwise use Carbon? Use Gemini 4 Neon at high. It matched Carbon's score on hard math for 0.73 times the cost.

text: Question four. Is response time the priority? Use Gemini 4 Hydrogen at its lowest setting. It solved 30 of 30 hard problems at 11.3 seconds each, the fastest Gemini 4 model.
